color.note: Warm neutrals, one hot brand orange, one cool teal. Orange carries identity; teal is the rare second voice.

tokens.name: solar
tokens.usage: Brand orange: the mark, primary buttons, key highlights. Put ink text on it, never white (white fails contrast).

tokens.name: solar-text
tokens.usage: Orange for text and links on surface (5.2:1 light, 8.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: ion
tokens.usage: Secondary accent for icons, charts, success and 'new' badges. Fills and icons only in light theme (3.1:1), not body text.

tokens.name: halo
tokens.usage: Soft orange tint: highlight backgrounds, selected rows, illustration relief.

tokens.name: deep
tokens.usage: Deep-space block: app icon ground, hero bands, dark cards.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface and on solar.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, taglines on surface (6.1:1 / 8.1:1).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, inputs above the surface.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Space Grotesk (Google Fonts): geometric, slightly technical. Headlines and the wordmark only.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Inter (Google Fonts) for all UI and reading text.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Edit, convert and create in seconds, right from your phone.

radius.note: Rounded like the orbit: soft corners, full circles for anything that orbits.
